initiatives.name: Racial Justice Coalition of San Diego
initiatives.description: Countywide coalition of about 25 San Diego organizations that works against racial discrimination and abusive policing in communities of color; also runs the Continuing the Conversation program on racism.

initiatives.name: SURJ North County San Diego
initiatives.description: North County San Diego chapter of Showing Up for Racial Justice. Volunteers organize white people for racial justice through education, action and local police accountability campaigns.

initiatives.name: United Against Police Terror San Diego
initiatives.description: San Diego copwatch and police accountability group. Runs a 24/7 copwatch hotline, documents police stops, and advocates for victims of excessive force.

initiatives.name: San Diego Brown Beret National Organization
initiatives.description: San Diego chapter of the Brown Beret National Organization, a Chicano community group. It does community service and activism in San Diego.

initiatives.name: Indivisible San Diego Persist
initiatives.description: San Diego Indivisible group formed by merging the Downtown and Central chapters. Organizes advocacy and events pushing back on the Trump administration and supporting local reforms.

initiatives.name: Change Begins With ME
initiatives.description: Indivisible-affiliated volunteer group based in San Diego's Golden Triangle that holds monthly meetings, candidate forums, rallies and voter postcard-writing campaigns.

initiatives.name: San Diego Black Panther Party
initiatives.description: San Diego chapter of the Black Panther Party. Runs community outreach and youth programs based on the Party's 10 Point Platform.

initiatives.name: Gente Unida
initiatives.description: San Diego nonprofit human rights border coalition founded by Enrique Morones in 2005; raises awareness of immigration issues and runs education and arts programs for migrant children in Baja shelters.

initiatives.name: Borderlands for Equity
initiatives.description: La Mesa-based group doing advocacy and training in San Diego County's border region, including bystander and anti-misogyny training, with a focus on BIPOC, immigrant and refugee communities.

initiatives.name: Community Advocates for Just and Moral Governance (MoGo)
initiatives.description: San Diego nonprofit that brings impact lawsuits and community education on police accountability, jail conditions and city government. Also runs town halls.

initiatives.name: Borderlands Relief Collective
initiatives.description: We leave supplies in the borderlands to support human rights, and to decrease the risk of death, for all people who cross through Kumeyaay land.

initiatives.name: Direct Action Drumline
initiatives.description: Protest Drumline, Zine Distro & Mutual Aid

initiatives.name: Anakbayan San Diego
initiatives.description: Filipino youth fighting for national democracy in the Philippines

initiatives.name: Palestinian Youth Movement San Diego
initiatives.description: A movement of Palestinian & Arab youth struggling for the liberation of our homeland.

initiatives.name: #borderclick
initiatives.description: Digital archive and photography project by young people who live between Tijuana and San Diego, documenting transborder life. Started in 2016 with The AjA Project.

initiatives.name: North County Mutual Aid Collection
initiatives.description: Mutual aid collective in North County, SD CA. Radical harm reduction and outreach crew.

initiatives.name: All We Got San Diego
initiatives.description: Volunteer mutual aid group in City Heights that packs and gives out weekly food bags across San Diego County, and has also helped migrants released at the San Diego airport.
